transcript: If you are a player that has your hands too close together, recognize that. Take that left hand or your guide hand and put it even like your fingers underneath right here. And now the shooting hand, I like to go split finger, but index works. Middle is okay. I don't like middle because it pushes this hand too far over, but it's not bad. I like splitting or index right here in the middle of the ball and then the guide hand slightly below right there. Just so now when I come up, wrist is facing down, which is perfect. And then I can release nice and easy.
